scope: Reusable whole-game systems, validated through original Act 1; this list is required coverage, not an exhaustive full-game inventory.
worker_policy: Bounded ordinary tasks use GPT-6 Luna HIGH; difficult tasks may escalate to GPT-6.1 Sol MEDIUM with recorded reason. Root and integration lead retain current models.

requirements.name: Enemy combat and AI
requirements.acceptance: Original aggro, movement, targeting, attacks, hit timing, reactions and death; enemies and player share canonical actor/combat owners.

requirements.name: Drops, looting, money and XP
requirements.acceptance: Authored drop tables, probability and conditions; pickup grants real inventory/currency/XP once, with source leveling and durable save behavior.

requirements.name: Skills, attack animation and weapon effects
requirements.acceptance: Original skill/attack clips and event markers drive effects; source weapon data selects sword trails, staff/ranged projectiles, damage and audio.

requirements.name: Breakable pots and contained rewards or mobs
requirements.acceptance: Render authored objects, destruction state/animation and source conditional contents through shared spawn/reward systems; no assumed always-spawn policy.

requirements.name: Chests and opening animations
requirements.acceptance: Original interaction, eligibility, opening sequence and reward timing; prevent repeated rewards and restore original persistent open state.

requirements.name: Tutorial HUD and cinematics at authored triggers
requirements.acceptance: Original progression/area triggers drive prompts, camera, actor clips, HUD visibility and control transitions; no diagnostic frame schedules.

requirements.name: Audio throughout gameplay and UI
requirements.acceptance: Original IDs and event timing for combat, skills, projectiles, impacts, deaths, loot, interactions, UI, companions, cinematics, ambience and music; unavailable assets remain documented.

requirements.name: Quests, NPC interaction and quest menu
requirements.acceptance: Original objectives, dialogue, NPC services, completion/rewards and progression use same live quest/event state projected into the character-menu Quest page.

requirements.name: HUD minimap and character-menu Map page
requirements.acceptance: Original map assets, projection, player/quest/NPC markers and source visibility/update rules; consistent full-window rendering and hits.

requirements.name: Castor and faery following and AI
requirements.acceptance: Source follow/master ownership, navigation, encounter behavior, target validity and save lifecycle; verify named Castor identity and whether/when he attacks.

requirements.name: Faery abilities, animations and effects
requirements.acceptance: Selection/unlocks and source abilities drive actual companion animation, timing, effects/audio and gameplay result through shared owners.

requirements.name: Animated world objects and progression barriers
requirements.acceptance: Generic authored object animation/enable state and quest/boss conditions support gates and barriers across all maps; persist and restore original state.

unverified_user_recollections.claim: A waterfall blocks exit until a witch is killed

shared_acceptance: Use original art, animation, gameplay rules and timing.
Observe real authored conditions and probabilities.
Verify integrated behavior, visual/reference appearance and save/reload across relevant states.
Component readiness does not establish packaged completion.
recommended_delivery_order: Publish canonical actor, inventory, quest and source UI owners needed by feature adapters.
Prove enemy engage/attack/death -> authored drop -> pickup -> XP/currency/inventory -> save/restore loop.
Add source skills, weapon effects/projectiles and their audio while full Equipment/Skills/Faery/Quest/Map pages continue in parallel.
Connect pots/chests, NPC/quest interactions and companions through the same owners.
Connect authored tutorials/cinematics, progression barriers and complete audio coverage; validate connected Act 1 playthrough.
